2.0.0: Breaking change: Improved the input options for components.
Breaking change: Set component now supports setting multiple key-value pairs at the same time.
2.0.1: Fixed SaveToFile component json2csv dependency imports to use v6+ scoped packages.
Fixed 'Transform is not a constructor' error when flattenValue is false and fileType is csv.
2.0.2: Output examples for all storage components. ListStores: the name and store id options had label and path swapped and now read [0].name / [0].storeId.
2.0.3: Create Store and List Stores: the store id of an existing store is sent as a string. It came out of the engine as an ObjectId and left the component as a Buffer, so a component fed with it (e.g. an AI Agent's Memory Data Store) rejected it as an invalid store id.
